Adjacent span[data-as=p] elements convert like paragraphs

```typescript title="WebAssembly"
import { convert } from "@xberg-io/html-to-markdown-wasm";
function main() {
  const result = convert("<div><span data-as=\"p\">First paragraph.</span><span data-as=\"p\">Second paragraph.</span></div>");
  console.log(result.content);
}

void main();
```
